ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-intensity dominance (~95% pixels < 50 intensity) with localized high-intensity peaks (>220 intensity) at the distal tips and specular reflections.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous low-intensity dark field across the main fluke surface; distinct high-contrast white/light-grey geometric clusters located at distal fluke tips; linear specular glints along the upper boundary of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow V-shaped notch with a calculated interior angle of approximately 42 degrees; notch depth is approximately 12% of the total visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular serration pattern along the continuous trailing boundary; includes multiple small-scale jagged peaks (2-5 pixel amplitude) and several distinct V-shaped micro-notches on the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex upward sweep; the upper trailing edge exhibits a slightly concave curve relative to the central axis before tapering to the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular white pixel aggregates at both the left and right distal tips, indicating prominent barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, non-parallel light-grey linear streaks visible on the surface of the right lobe, oriented diagonally toward the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle clusters at distal tips; multiple small irregular notches/chips along the trailing edge suggesting minor physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced specular highlights at the center base where the fluke meets the water surface.
